senses.gloss:
(डु) डुवप r. 1st cl. (वपति)
1 To sow seed.
2 To procreate.
3 To shave.
4 To weave.

m. (-पः)
1 Shaving.
2 Sowing seed.
3 Weaving.
f. (-पा)
1 The mucous or glutinous secretion of the flesh or bones; according to some, also the marrow of the bones.
2 Any hole or cavity.
E.
वप to sow seed, &c., aff. अच्.

m. (-पः)
1 Shaving.
2 Sowing seed.
3 Weaving.
E.
वप to sow seed, &c., aff. घञ्.

n. (-नं)
1 Sowing seed.
2 Shaving.
3 Semen virile.
f. (-नी)
A barber's shop.
E.
वप to shave, &c., aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-कृत्)
Marrow.
E.
वपा, and कृत what makes.

m. (-लः)
A father.
E.
वप to sow seed, (figuratively,) and इलच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-नः)
A deity.
n. (-नं)
Knowledge.
E.
वप to sow, उवन् aff.

f. (-मा)
A plant, (Hibiscus mutabilis.)

mfn. (-ष्मान्-ष्मन्ती-ष्मत्)
Having a body, corporeal^1, incarnate.
E.
वपुस्, and मतुप् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

n. (-पुः)
1 The body.
2 A handsome form or figure.
E.
वप to sow, Uṇādi aff. उसि.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 To be sown.
2 To be given, conferred, implanted, &c.
3 To be immitted seminally, to be impregnated or begotten.
E.
वप to sow, तव्य aff.; also वपनीय, &c.

mfn. (-प्ता-प्ती-प्तृ)
A sower, a planter, &c.
m. (-प्ता)
1 A father, a progenitor.
2 A poet, a sage.
E.
वप to sow, aff. तृच्.

mn. (-प्रः-प्रं)
1 A field.
2 A rampart, a mud wall, earth taken from the ditch of a town and raised as a wall or buttress, or as the foundation of a wall of masonry, &c.
3 The foundation of any building.
4 The gate of a fortified city.
5 A shore or bank.
6 Dust, earth.
7 A mound, a hillock.
m. (-प्रः)
A father.
n. (-प्रं)
Lead.
f. (-प्री)
A hillock, an ant-hill.
E.
वरु to sow, रन् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-डा)
Butting, as of an elephant or bull, &c.
E.
वप्र a mound, and कीडा sport.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Bowed or stooping to butt at a wall or bank.
E.
वप्र, and आनत bent.

ind.
In or between banks, mounds, &c.
E.
वप्र, and आन्तर् within.

m. (-तः)
Butting at a bank or mound.
E.
वप्र, and अभिघात striking.

n. (-म्भः)
The water near or along the bank.
E.
वप्र, and अम्भस water.

m. (-प्रिः)
A field.
E.
वप to sow, Uṇādi aff. क्रिन्.

m. (-ण्डः)
A weaver's loom.
E.
वाप weaving, दण्ड a stick; also वायदण्ड.

f. (-पिः or -पी)
A large oblong pond, a pool, a lake.
E.
वप, to sow seed, (of the lotus, &c.) Uṇādi aff. इञ्, and ङीप् optionally added.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Sown as seed.
2 Shaven.
E.
वाप shaving, &c., इतच् aff.

m. (-हः)
The Cātaka, a bird, (Cuculus melanoleucos.)
E.
वापी a pool, हां to abandon, aff. क; drinking rain water only.

mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
To be sown, what may or ought to be sown.
m. (-प्यः)
A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.)
E.
वप to sow, aff. ण्यत्.
